lines.say: You can follow every worked example in the lecture, and still freeze on the problem sheet.
That's because recognising a method isn't the same as being able to use it.
There's research on this. Rereading feels better on the day, but a week later, the students who tested themselves remembered more. It's called the testing effect.
So that's what Offload makes you do.
Feynman prompts to explain the method, then exam-style questions on your own module notes.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
